about: Guesses an open-pass reviewer wrote and tested. A guess that held on several repos is a candidate kind.

guesses.guess: Update-mask paths
guesses.perspective: new: no recorded seam covers field masks
guesses.held: Held, recorded update-mask-paths and one bug.
guesses.test: grep web/src for updateMask, paths: and mask.add; grep server/router/api/v1 for UpdateMask.Paths; compare the path sets RPC by RPC, and compare each update_mask field_behavior with the handler's nil check.

guesses.guess: Store cache keys and invalidation
guesses.held: Did not hold: every key comes from a helper inside package store (userCacheKey, getUserSettingCacheKey, Key.String()), every write goes through a store method that sets or deletes the key, and the only Store.GetDriver() caller outside store is GetDatabaseSize.
guesses.test: grep Cache.Set, Cache.Get and Cache.Delete in store/*.go, and GetDriver() across the repo.

guesses.guess: Store and API setting converters
guesses.test: a script parses every message in proto/store/instance_setting.proto, proto/store/user_setting.proto, proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto and proto/api/v1/user_service.proto (regex on 'type name = N' inside a brace-tracked message stack), pairs the setting messages, and requires each shared field's Go name in both the FromStore and ToStore converter bodies. Only api_key is one-way, on purpose.

guesses.guess: Theme token sets
guesses.test: a script extracts each theme file's :root custom properties, compares the color tokens with default.css (27 in each file), and compares the backticked tokens in COLOR_GUIDE.md with that set.

guesses.guess: Locale placeholders and keys used in code
guesses.perspective: deeper look at locale-message-keys, which checked key presence only
guesses.test: a script flattens the 42 non-English locale files and compares each key's set of {{var}} placeholders with en.json (0 mismatches), and matches t('...') calls and key-shaped string literals in web/src against en.json (0 missing). The dynamic families attachment-library.tabs.*, editor.format.heading-N (capped at 3 in MemoEditor/Editor/formatting.ts:116), memo.visibility.*, setting.notification.requirement-* and live-update.* all exist. Literal keys are already type-checked through the Translations type in web/src/utils/i18n.ts:54-62, which pnpm lint runs with tsc.

guesses.guess: Error codes and messages the web branches on
guesses.held: Not a seam: the web branches only on Connect codes (connect.ts:106, lib/query-client.ts:10, hooks/useMemoDetailError.ts:19, pages/MemoDetail.tsx:73), convertGRPCError casts the gRPC code (connect_handler.go:65-80), and no web code matches message text.

guesses.guess: Browser storage keys and URL parameters inside web
guesses.held: Held for the sign-out list, recorded signout-preserved-storage-keys.
guesses.test: grep localStorage, sessionStorage, useLocalStorage, searchParams and '?param=' builders in web/src. The filter parameter goes through shared helpers, and the thumbnail and share_token URLs are already in file-route-urls. The memos.metadata.head and memos.metadata.body comment markers in web/index.html have no consumer anywhere in the repo.

guesses.guess: Release version
guesses.held: Not a seam: .release-please-manifest.json (0.29.1) and CHANGELOG.md are both written by release-please, internal/version.Version is 'dev' unless ldflags set it (version-ldflags), and the schema version comes from migration file names (store/migrator.go:299-319).

guesses.guess: Admin-only RPCs
guesses.test: a script lists every rpc in proto/api/v1/*.proto, extracts the body of each APIV1Service handler, and flags RoleAdmin, isSuperUser and fetchCurrentUser; every instance-wide handler checks ADMIN (instance_service.go:149, :188, :245; instance_stats.go:55; idp_service.go:24, :84, :147; user_service.go:71, :183, :344, :360, :394).

guesses.guess: CI path filters against what each job reads
guesses.test: read every paths filter in .github/workflows, list the go:embed directives, and run git log --name-only for commits that touched only store/migration, store/seed or proto/gen/openapi.yaml. frontend-tests (web/**) and proto-linter (proto/**) cover their inputs.

guesses.guess: Generated outputs versus the proto sources
guesses.test: a script reads every field, enum value and rpc in proto/api/v1 and proto/store (704 members), looks for 'name=<field>' in the matching .pb.go and for the camelCase name or oneof case in the matching _pb.ts; all are present, and the headers show one generator version per plugin. Byte-for-byte equality needs buf generate with network access and was not checked.

guesses.guess: Request metadata keys
guesses.test: every md.Get key under server/ against the keys MetadataInterceptor sets.

guesses.guess: Driver error text for unique violations
guesses.test: grep 'UNIQUE constraint', 'duplicate key' and 'Duplicate entry' across server, store and internal.

guesses.guess: Inbox notification types
guesses.test: grep InboxMessage_MEMO_ and UserNotification_Type across server, store and web; the payload-to-memo-ID switch exists in five files.

guesses.guess: Numeric limits shared by web and server
guesses.held: Held with drift, recorded memo-content-length-limit and transcription-config-length-caps.
guesses.test: grep 'too long' and 'maximum length' in server and internal, and maxLength and min= in web/src.

guesses.guess: Proto request docs versus handlers
guesses.test: read every page_size, order_by and filter comment in proto/api/v1, and grep request.PageSize and request.OrderBy in server/router/api/v1.

guesses.guess: Rarely run writers: migrations that write JSON into proto-backed columns. Check: grep store/migration for json_ functions and JSON literals and compare the keys with protojson names. The 0.27 STORAGE value (storageType DATABASE) and the 0.27 inbox rewrite (memoComment.memoId, relatedMemoId) match the store protos; the 0.30 copy of instance TAGS into user TAGS depends on two mirrored messages, recorded tag-metadata-json-shape.
Memo deletion versus the user-delete cascade
guesses.held: Held with drift, recorded memo-delete-dependents and reaction-content-id-format.
guesses.test: compare what store.DeleteMemo and APIV1Service.DeleteMemo delete with deleteUserTargetsTx in the three drivers, then trace reaction content_id writers and readers.

guesses.guess: AI provider types
guesses.held: Held, no drift, recorded ai-provider-types and extended ai-provider-defaults with the save-time endpoint fill.
guesses.test: grep OPENAI, GEMINI and ProviderType in proto, internal/ai, server and web.

guesses.guess: READMEs and guides nobody opened. Held with drift, recorded web-component-readmes and internal-email-readme, and extended toolchain-versions with the email README's Go line. Check: list every name, file and behavior each README states (MemoEditor, ConfirmDialog, ui, MemoContent/markdown, internal/email) and look each up in its folder; internal/cron/README.md is one line and agrees.
Client cache keys. Not a seam: web/src/hooks defines key factories (memoKeys, userKeys, attachmentKeys, instanceKeys, memoShareKeys), and the only literal query key is the geocoding one.
Docker build context. Not a seam: .dockerignore excludes nothing that a go:embed directive or scripts/Dockerfile needs.
